Since 2015 · Small Batch

Our Story

From our kitchen to your celebration

Our kitchen runs on real butter, patience, and the belief that dessert is the emotional peak of every gathering. Since 2015 we've baked hundreds of custom cakes for weddings, birthdays, and “just because” Tuesdays across Springfield.

Every cake starts with a conversation — your story, your flavours, your favourite flowers — and ends with something almost too pretty to cut. Almost.

  • European-style butter & real vanilla bean
  • Small-batch sponges, never frozen
  • Free design consult with every order

The Process

Easy as cake

Four calm steps between craving and candle-blowing.

  1. 1

    Browse & Inspire

    Wander the gallery and menu, and save everything that makes your heart skip.

  2. 2

    Request a Quote

    Tell us the occasion, date, and headcount — we reply within one business day, usually faster.

  3. 3

    Consultation & Tasting

    Meet the bakers, taste six signature flavour pairings, and finalise your design together.

  4. 4

    Delivery & Setup

    We deliver, assemble, and style your cake to the minute — you take all the credit.
